ModMetaData.name: SloppyMod Trash POWER!
ModMetaData.author: kanid99
ModMetaData.description:
Build 0.9.53
Burn the trashbricks from Vanilla Recycling Expanded for power.
Trash gasification: a jerry-rigged cobbled trash gasifier and a cleaner, safer trash gasifier that burn trashbricks. Feed them by hand or from a hopper on their intake, and pipe their exhaust to an exhaust port outside - or it fills their room with toxic gas.
Advanced play mode (default): gasifiers are burners with eco, normal and high modes - the trash gasifier makes 1500W of heat on 75 bricks a day. Pipe them to steam turbines with three gears, radiators and an Overpressure Tank. With no turbine, their own Stirling engine makes a little power. Large (3x4) and industrial (3x6) burners need turbines. Simple play mode: the gasifiers are self-contained 1000W and 1200W generators.
With Dubs Bad Hygiene: fecal sludge pellets as a second fuel, and a plumbing connection. Stoves heat the plumbing's hot water with whatever the turbines don't use. With Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Factory: belt-fed through factory hoppers.
Needs Vanilla Recycling Expanded, and is researched after complex recycling.
